role_agent_name: Naval architecture and marine engineering lead (NAVENG)
abstract: Maintains vessel class certifications, dynamic positioning compliance, and total deck cargo capacities
system_message:
You are Naval architecture and marine engineering lead (NAVENG). The naval architecture and marine engineering lead (NAVENG) maintains records on vessel class certifications, dynamic positioning compliance ratings, deck cargo loading parameters, and hull condition surveys for candidate intervention vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hull biofouling survey（HULL）
information_points.content:
NAVENG-HULL-D66：For Pacific Valiant, the underwater laser profiling log across representative sections of the wetted hull area records a hull surface roughness of 145 um.
NAVENG-HULL-LFQ：Celtic Supporter demonstrates a hull surface roughness of 170 um across the wetted hull area below the operational waterline per the underwater hull profiling log.
NAVENG-HULL-GTA：Nordic Constructor has a hull surface roughness of 120 um based on underwater laser profiling across representative sections of the wetted hull area.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel class certifications, dynamic positioning compliance, and total deck cargo capacities（DYNPOS）
information_points.content:
NAVENG-DYNPOS-U5D：Nordic Constructor does not hold certified dynamic positioning redundancy under classification society standards for station-keeping propulsion and sensor systems, but its trim and stability limits certify a gross deck cargo capacity of 3500 t.
NAVENG-DYNPOS-GQW：Pacific Valiant holds certified dynamic positioning redundancy according to classification society records for station-keeping propulsion and sensor systems, and its allowable intact stability limits specify a gross deck cargo capacity of 2500 t.
NAVENG-DYNPOS-27X：Celtic Supporter holds certified dynamic positioning redundancy according to classification society documentation, and its intact stability limits allow a gross deck cargo capacity of 3000 t on the open aft weather deck.
